title: Blood RNA signature RISK4LEP predicts leprosy years before clinical onset
description: Exploratory RNA expression analysis during development of leprosy allows identification of RISK4LEP, a 4-gene blood RNA signature predicting leprosy years before clinical onset. Overall design: Comparison of blood transcriptomics in leprosy progressors before symptoms (First), at diagnosis (Second) and household contact controls (HHC)
